standard_prerequisites.name: Soundness theorem
standard_prerequisites.use: Satisfying structures make provable-from-Gamma formulas true, in particular falsum is never satisfiable.

core_obligations: Statement (lines 1828-1831): if Gamma is satisfiable, then it is consistent.

Proof (lines 1833-1844): contraposition - if Gamma is inconsistent there is a derivation of falsum; by soundness any structure satisfying Gamma would satisfy falsum, which no structure does, so Gamma is unsatisfiable.
difficulty_reason: Soundness corollary (statement 1828-1831, proof 1833-1844): complete two-step contrapositive through the soundness theorem. H2.
